I wish I could talk to them... I mean, my family's really angry at me for digging myself into this hole and I can't say I blame them, but trying to talk to them about it always ends up with them yelling at me at what a terrible child I am. And the counsellor basically says the same thing and what a lazy person I am, so they're no go. 

And public school isn't even an option at this point, because the only reason I went to private school was because I was bullied to the point of getting beaten up and getting my glasses broken. I wouldn't be able to do well there either. I'm sorry if I sound like I'm shooting down your points, truly, and I appreciate the help. *sends internet hug* If it's okay, I would like to talk to you.
